note: Per-node hourly mean deviation from the regional SMP (LMP - SMP = loss + congestion, PhP/kWh), from DIPCEF final 5-minute results, derived at archive time because the raw hourly zips are too heavy to commit and the public window rolls. The published LMP_CONGESTION column is zero through the WESM suspension window and small and intermittent after real-time pricing resumed on 2026-05-01; congestion_php_kwh carries the nonzero node-hours.
